title: A list by the aisles of your own store
description: Setting up a convenient order once and keeping the corrections for the trips that follow.

blocks.text: The shopper arranges the aisles once, the way they walk their own store. The next list is assembled in that order; a product moved by hand stays in the aisle chosen for it in future too.

quote.text: Now, every item on my list is assigned an aisle in the store where I shop, and items are grouped by aisles. I can zip through the store!

blocks.text: An order the shopper already knows
Maps of every store are not needed to begin with. Your own aisle names, a simple way to change the order and a separate setup for a second regular store are enough.
A small setup instead of a map

The benefit shows on a long, familiar list: can it be worked through without walking back and without searching every item. This is a strong feature for a shopping list; on its own, sorting may be too narrow a reason to move to a new app.
